title: Campus Yard Sale
description: CAB presents the annual Campus Yard Sale, where you can meet amazing Registered Student Organizations (RSOs) at UCF. Enjoy free goodies and drinks, including apple cider, while supplies last! This event is a great way to connect with other students and learn more about student-run organizations on campus.

title: Silversun Pickups In-Store Acoustic Performance and Signing
description: Join us on Sunday, October 11th at 1 PM for a special acoustic in-store performance featuring Brian & Nikki from Silversun Pickups, followed by a full band signing! Limited space may be available for the performance portion, so arrive early to secure your spot. Each purchase of an SSPU album grants entry to the signing portion.
